name: How long does it take to replace cracked window glass?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace cracked window glass?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required for cracked window glass replacement varies depending on the type of window, the extent of the damage, and whether custom glass needs to be ordered. Simple single-pane replacements might be completed within a few hours once the glass is on-site. For insulated glass units (IGUs) or specialty glass, there's typically a lead time of several days to a few weeks for manufacturing and delivery of the new unit. Once the glass arrives, installation usually takes a few hours per window.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation typically takes a few hours once the glass is on-site. There may be a lead time of several days to weeks for custom or insulated glass units.
